hints.title: Suffix Partitioning
hints.text: Break down the string suffix by suffix to count leftover letters.

hints.title: Subproblem Recurrence
hints.text: Let each index record the optimal result for the remainder of the text.

hints.title: Transition Choices
hints.text: Either treat the current character as unused or match a valid word from the dictionary.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Quadratic state exploration over string substrings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking without memoization branches exponentially on overlapping word prefixes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Table of size n caches optimal partition costs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes overlapping subproblems and models suffix transitions.
